result.notes: Clay launched a new Public API (api.clay.com/public/v0, July 2026) authenticated with a single 'clay-api-key' header; key creation is self-serve under Settings→Account→API keys (beta) with no explicit plan gate stated in the auth docs. However, Clay's own pricing page lists 'Clay API access' as an Enterprise-tier (custom pricing, contact sales) feature, distinct from the Growth-tier 'Integrate with any HTTP API' (outbound enrichment columns) and Free-tier 'bring your own third-party API key' features — creating ambiguity about whether the beta Public API is broadly self-serve or Enterprise-only. Sided with the pricing page as the more authoritative access signal, hence paid_plan/enterprise_only with moderate confidence. Separately, Clay publishes an official hosted remote MCP server (api.clay.com/v3/mcp) with a free-credit on-ramp (500 credits on first connect per third-party summary), which is not gated the same way.
result.one_liner: Clay is a GTM data enrichment and outbound automation platform (100+ data providers, AI research agent 'Claygent', and workflow tables) that exposes a public HTTP API and an official MCP server for external/agent access.
